payload.recallText: Joe was in a room with his sister Clara. He was reading a letter and making remarks to Clara while watching the snow fall outside. He told her he wouldn't be playing for the Pittson baseball team and Clara asked him if he had lost his spot. He was vague in his reply and while pretending to pitch, his mother walked in and his arm hit a jug of water she was carrying and got water on the floor. His mom, who he refers to as Momsey, was upset the the floor would be ruined, but was glad her son was not hurt. Joe then finally told them that it looks like he was being drafted to the the major league and that he was being considered as a pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals. They were excited for him and he hoped for more money and fame, while recognizing his competition and the hard work ahead of him.
